reason: An IDE engineering services plugin centered on language-server diagnostics and navigation, debugger integration, and discovery or execution of common project tasks for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript.

summaries.zh: 为 Python 和 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目提供语言服务器诊断与导航、调试器集成以及 npm、Make 和 just 任务发现与执行。
summaries.en: Provides Python and JavaScript/TypeScript projects with language-server diagnostics and navigation, debugger integration, and discovery or execution of npm, Make, and just tasks.

capabilities: Provides LSP diagnostics, code navigation, symbol search, and rename operations for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
Provides debug sessions with debugpy and js-debug actions
Discovers and runs npm, Makefile, and justfile tasks
Invokes configured language servers, debug adapters, and workspace task commands
